rationale: This CBb decision concerns statutory interpretation of the grid connection obligation (aansluitplicht) and the 18-week deadline for connections under 10 MVA (megavolt-ampere) pursuant to Article 23(3) of the Dutch Electricity Act (Elektriciteitswet 1998 / E-wet). Under the protocol rules, electricity network aansluitplicht disputes are explicitly NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
